newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals prices mixed, industrial demand down.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals prices mixed, industrial demand down.

text.p: Indian base metals prices on Tuesday continued steady in a narrow price band, dealers said.
Copper was steady at 13,525 rupees per quintal after gaining 25 rupees on Monday. It was down by 125 rupees last week.
Tin and nickel held steady at the reduced level on eased pressure of arrivals but volumes were thin due to poor offtake.

Tin was steady at 28,500 rupees per quintal after losing 200 rupees on Monday while nickel was quiet at 33,400 rupees per quintal after losing 200 rupees on Monday. Last week tin was down by 300 rupees and nickel was down by 200 rupees per quintal.
Zinc was steady at 8,250 rupees per quintal but undercurrent was firm on a rising world market.
"Zinc prices in the world market has risen to a seven-year high," one broker said.
Lead was quoted at the previous level of 4,150 rupees, aluminium at 7,700 rupees per quintal amid nominal activity.
